full_name: Rajiv Sethi | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2020–2021 Social Sciences Joy Foundation Fellow Barnard College
bio: Rajiv Sethi is a professor of economics at Barnard College, Columbia University, and an external professor at the Santa Fe Institute. He is a coauthor, with Brendan O’Flaherty, of Shadows of Doubt: Stereotypes, Crime, and the Pursuit of Justice (Harvard University Press, 2019).
